description: Create a new enemy in data/Enemies.json. Only `name` is required; omitted fields use the editor's new-enemy defaults (100 HP, one Attack action, no drops). Allocates the next unused enemy id and returns `{ enemy, warnings? }` (warn-by-default: a `battlerName` not found in img/enemies (img/sv_enemies for a side-view project) is flagged, never blocked). Throws if an `actions[].skillId` or a `dropItems[].dataId` (item/weapon/armor by `kind`) references a record that does not exist. NOTE: an enemy with no Hit Rate trait (xparam id 0: trait { code: 22, dataId: 0, value: 0.95 }) always misses physical actions — pass one in `traits` if the enemy should land basic attacks.

actions.description: Action patterns { skillId, conditionType, conditionParam1, conditionParam2, rating }

battlerName.description: Battler graphic filename (img/enemies; img/sv_enemies when System.optSideView)

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

name.description: Enemy name shown in battle and the database

params.description: 8 base params: [maxHP, maxMP, atk, def, mat, mdf, agi, luk]

name: create_enemy
